blockedIdentities.reason: The exact SELI TUNNEL record is a legacy tunnelling identity associated with business units that later moved to different current companies. No manufacturer-owned source supports publishing it as one unambiguous current manufacturer entity.

SENTRY is shared by multiple unrelated industrial companies and product brands. The undifferentiated repository record has no legal-name, domain or product-scope discriminator that selects one manufacturer safely.

Severn Trent De Nora is a former joint-venture identity rather than a current independent manufacturer. Current De Nora sources do not support publishing the exact legacy composite as a standalone canonical entity.
SEWON matches several unrelated active Korean manufacturers in hydraulics, marine valves, machinery and automation. The bare repository name provides no authoritative discriminator.

Frontmatec's official history confirms that SFK LEBLANC was one of the companies merged into Frontmatec. It is not presented as a current standalone commercial manufacturer, so a separate indexable identity would duplicate the successor.
